value.rationale: The seven-vertex torus is the unique vertex-minimal torus and a canonical tight neighborly surface. The finding refines the qualitative tightness statement into a complete local-to-global image spectrum: it identifies every minimal three-vertex support, a sharp complement switch at four vertices, and the least vertex count forcing the full global first homology. This is a natural structural invariant of the canonical model rather than an arbitrary slice.
